title: Passkeys are not a trap
why_read: A pointed rebuttal in the ongoing passkeys adoption debate, worth reading for engineers deciding whether to implement WebAuthn-based passwordless auth and weighing lock-in concerns.
analysis: Passkeys have faced criticism for tying credentials to platform ecosystems (Apple, Google, Microsoft) raising fears of vendor lock-in and recovery problems; this piece argues against that framing. The high comment count signals a contentious but technically substantive discussion about key portability, backup mechanisms, and real-world UX failures of WebAuthn. For engineers implementing authentication systems, understanding both sides of this debate has direct practical value.
